summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of 12.3 million units at US$0.20 each per unit, each unit consisting of one ADS (representing eight Class A ordinary shares) and a warrant to purchase three ADSs at US$0.25 per ADS. Gross proceeds are US$2.46 million, with potential additional US$9.225 million if warrants exercised. It is a routine capital-raising transaction for working capital and general corporate purposes, not a special situation. The securities are unregistered and sold under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act.
